svg.title: Factonio Architecture and Verification Information Barrier
svg.desc: Four-phase software factory pipeline: Define, optional Phase 1b Design, parallel worktree Implementation, and isolated parallel Verification (Diff Check and Black-Box Check separated by an information barrier), followed by exact-HEAD PR gate and merge.
svg.text: Pure-Hermes software factory on a headless worker profile (git + gh + Kanban)

g.text: Blind to git diff & source (no bias)
• Tick Watchdog flags stale heartbeats & blocked cards • /factonio Dashboard tracks pass rates, rework, escape rate & inline repo settings
• Docked Right-Sidebar Tab shows live workstream pipelines & card drawers • Escaped bug tracking feeds directly back into metrics
